wwox_form: Flag-Wwox full length or Flag-Wwox delta5-8
ack1_perturbation: myc-Ack1: wild type (wAck), kinase-dead K158R (kdAck), activated L487F (caAck), vector; all C-terminally truncated (residues 788-1036 absent)
measure: IP Flag: IB myc (association), pTyr (Wwox), Ub; IP Myc: IB pTyr and Ack1
control_available: wAck, kdAck and vector lanes on the same blot
observation: Full-length Wwox: pTyr and a heavy Ub smear with caAck (lane 3), little with wAck, none with kdAck or vector; Wwox no longer co-precipitates with caAck. Delta5-8 associates with caAck and is not phosphorylated or polyubiquitinated (lane 7)
inference_by_authors: Tyrosine phosphorylation is a prerequisite for polyubiquitination
limit_or_not_tested: Overexpression of an engineered, truncated, constitutively active kinase in non-neural cells; the denaturing or non-denaturing IP condition for the Ub blot was not examined here; delta5-8 also lacks the ADH domain (site and domain confounded); one blot per panel as printed

figure: Fig 5E (text: Activated Ack1 promotes Wwox polyubiquitination and degradation)
cell_system: HEK293T, 36 h co-transfection then cycloheximide 3 h
measure: IP Wwox: IB Wwox, actin; with and without CHX
control_available: NONE for activated Ack1: every lane carries caAck; the contrast is CHX -/+ and isoform full length versus delta5-8
observation: Full-length Wwox band falls with CHX (lane 2); delta5-8 band does not (lane 4)
inference_by_authors: Activated Ack1 mediated phosphorylation and polyubiquitination resulting in degradation
limit_or_not_tested: No arm without activated Ack1 (wild-type, kinase-dead or vector) in the chase; one blot, one time point, no quantification or half-life; the isoform contrast does not isolate the kinase; the Wwox protein difference might also reflect isoform stability independent of Ack1

cell_system: LNCaP and HEK293T, caAck transfected, MG-132 3 h
control_available: MG-132 minus versus plus; no vector or kinase-dead lane in this panel
observation: Polyubiquitinated species are detected after MG-132 (lanes 2 and 4)
inference_by_authors: Ack1 activation results in polyubiquitination of endogenous Wwox
limit_or_not_tested: Ubiquitination of endogenous Wwox is shown only in caAck cells and only revealed by MG-132; Wwox level after MG-132 is not shown; proteasomal degradation is inferred, and lysosomal or other routes are not tested here (the discussion cites a different group for proteasome-dependent accumulation of a truncated Wwox)

measure: IP Flag: IB pTyr, Wwox, Ub; IP Myc: IB Ack1
observation: Y33F is phosphorylated and polyubiquitinated with caAck as wild type is
inference_by_authors: The ubiquitination-targeting phosphorylation is at a site other than Tyr33
limit_or_not_tested: The legend title mentions degradation but no level or chase panel is shown for Y33F

figure: Fig 7B (Tyr to Phe scan of the C-terminal region)
wwox_form: Flag-Wwox or seven single Tyr-to-Phe mutants (Y238F, Y287F, Y293F, Y328F, Y338F, Y361F, Y375F)
measure: IP Flag: IB pTyr, Wwox; IP Myc: IB pTyr (Ack1)
observation: Y287F has the weakest pTyr signal, not absent; Y375F also looks weaker; others near wild type (by eye, no quantification)
inference_by_authors: Tyr287 is the predominant but perhaps not the only phosphorylation site
limit_or_not_tested: No ubiquitin, stability or chase read-out for any mutant: it is not shown that Y287F resists ubiquitination or degradation

cell_system: 16 androgen-independent prostate cancers versus 16 benign prostates
measure: IP Ack1: IB pTyr, Ack1; IP Wwox: IB Wwox; densitometry
observation: Phospho-Ack1 about 4-5 fold higher (p<0.02); total Ack1 similar (p=0.67); Wwox lower (p=0.02)
inference_by_authors: Autophosphorylated Ack1 regulates Wwox by phosphorylation, polyubiquitination and degradation
limit_or_not_tested: Between-group correlation of band intensities, not causal; non-neural; Wwox transcript level not measured here

measure: Ack1 kinase assay and p-Ack blot; tumour growth in nude mice (n=10)
observation: Geldanamycin removes caAck kinase activity and delays caAck tumours
inference_by_authors: Hsp90beta maintains the active Ack1 conformation
limit_or_not_tested: No Wwox level is measured after any Ack1-directed intervention; no ACK1-selective inhibitor in this paper

inference_by_authors: Tyr287 phosphorylation as a second hit diminishing functional Wwox
limit_or_not_tested: Speculation in the authors' words ('Our data lead us to speculate'); neuron, Q230P and G372R are not addressed anywhere in the paper
